from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import sys

home = Path.home()
wake_dir = home / ".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
state_dir = home / ".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks"
task_id = "DEV-PRED-CONT-NEXT-09bfdedea81fbfe9f3b3291e"

def load(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None

state = load(state_dir / f"{task_id}.json")
route = load(wake_dir / "routes" / f"{task_id}.json")
print("B_STATE_STATUS=" + repr(state.get("status") if isinstance(state, dict) else None))
print("B_STATE_AUTO=" + repr(state.get("auto_continue") if isinstance(state, dict) else None))
print("B_STATE_PARENT=" + repr(state.get("parent_continuation_id") if isinstance(state, dict) else None))
print("B_STATE_CHAT=" + repr(state.get("chat_id") if isinstance(state, dict) else None))
print("B_ROUTE=" + repr(route))

for name in ("outbox","inflight","sent"):
    d = wake_dir / name
    hits = []
    if d.is_dir():
        for p in d.glob("*.json"):
            obj = load(p)
            if isinstance(obj, dict) and obj.get("task_id") == task_id:
                hits.append({
                    "file": p.name,
                    "event_id": obj.get("event_id"),
                    "source": obj.get("source"),
                    "message_prefix": str(obj.get("message") or "")[:80],
                })
    print(f"B_{name.upper()}=" + repr(hits))

sys.path.insert(0, str(wake_dir))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installed_bridge_e017", wake_dir / "bridge_server.py")
wake = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
assert spec.loader is not None
spec.loader.exec_module(wake)
base = wake.base
print("WAKE_SERVER_VERSION=" + repr(getattr(wake.Handler,"server_version",None)))
print("BASE_HAS_ACK_HOOK=" + repr(hasattr(base,"ACK_HOOK")))
print("BASE_ACK_HOOK=" + repr(getattr(getattr(base,"ACK_HOOK",None),"__name__",None)))
print("BASE_RELEASE_LEASE=" + repr(getattr(getattr(base,"release_lease",None),"__name__",None)))
print("BASE_RELEASE_MODULE=" + repr(getattr(getattr(base,"release_lease",None),"__module__",None)))
print("CONT_HOOK_EXPECTED=" + repr(getattr(wake,"continuation_ack_hook",None) is getattr(base,"ACK_HOOK",None)))
print("CONT_RELEASE_EXPECTED=" + repr(getattr(wake,"continuation_release_lease",None) is getattr(base,"release_lease",None)))
print("ROUTE_BINDING=" + repr(base.route_binding_for_task(task_id)))
print("SOURCE_ALLOWS_AUTO=" + repr(wake.continuation.source_allows_auto_continue(state_dir, task_id)))
cid = wake.continuation.ids_for(task_id)["continuation_id"]
cp = wake.continuation.continuation_path(base.DATA_DIR, cid)
print("EXPECTED_CID=" + cid)
print("CONT_FILE=" + str(cp))
print("CONT_EXISTS=" + repr(cp.is_file()))
print("E017_DIAG=PASS")
